commands:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin
git checkout integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
git reset --hard origin/integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "a5ad4d5cf5d9faf8c12de571ea088a4b6e2893e3" ]
printf '%s\n' '=== AF endpoint descriptor/registration ==='
sed -n '250,560p' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/af.h
printf '%s\n' '=== temperature cluster descriptor ==='
sed -n '1,180p' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/cluster/temperature_measurement_desc.h
printf '%s\n' '=== basic cluster descriptor ==='
sed -n '1,180p' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/cluster/basic_desc.h
printf '%s\n' '=== core/start/network ==='
grep -R -n -E 'ezb_.*start|ezb_.*init|network_steer|steering|commission' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/{core.h,bdb.h,nwk.h} | head -n 220
printf '%s\n' '=== app signal registration ==='
sed -n '1,220p' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/app_signals.h
